subject: Advance billing plan: annual prepay allocation, VAT owner matrix, and usage drawdown tracker
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance billing plan: annual prepay questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move forward. Before we finalize the amendment and PO, finance asked me to confirm a couple of operational details around the annual prepay and how drawdowns will be reflected on their ledger:

- Can you confirm the proposed invoicing sequence if we sign the amendment next month? (we prefer a single annual prepay invoice but need monthly statements showing drawdowns).
- How will VAT be handled? Acme is based in the US but has EU subsidiaries — we need to know if Redwood will supply VAT invoices per entity or if we should use reverse-charge.
- Can you provide a single-file drawdown tracker (CSV or sheet) so our accounting team can reconcile monthly consumption to the prepay balance?
- Do you support an escrow holdback for a portion of the prepay until deliverables (SLA/Uptime) are accepted? If yes, what is the process for release?

Attached: signed_sow_acme_q3_2026.pdf (executed SOW).

Would appreciate a short calendar and owner matrix that we can circulate to our finance and legal teams.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Analytics

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance billing plan: annual prepay questions

Hi Samantha — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Below is our proposed operational plan; happy to iterate based on Acme's preferences.

1) Invoicing sequence (recommended):
   - Invoice #1 (Annual prepay): issued on the agreement effective date (we typically schedule this as the first business day of the month following signature).
   - Monthly statements: on the 5th of each month we will issue a PDF statement showing that month's drawdowns and the remaining prepay balance. These are for reconciliation and will reference the invoice number for the annual prepay.
   - End-of-year reconciliation: a single credit/debit invoice if actual usage differs materially from prepay (thresholds outlined in the SOW).

2) Drawdown tracker / format:
   - We will maintain a shared CSV (monthly rows) and can also push a read-only Google Sheet if you prefer. I have attached a draft billing calendar (draft-billing-calendar.xlsx) that maps invoice dates to statement dates and GL memo fields.

3) VAT handling:
   - For US-entity billings we will issue standard supplier invoices (no VAT).
   - For EU subsidiaries: we can either (A) issue supplier VAT invoices per EU entity (requires you to provide local VAT registration details and billing entity), or (B) support reverse-charge where your EU entity is VAT-registered and can self-account — we will need a VAT owner matrix with legal entity names and VAT numbers to follow route A or B.

4) Escrow holdback:
   - We can support a 10% holdback on the annual prepay payable to an agreed escrow agent. Release conditions are: (a) sustained uptime for first 90 days, (b) acceptance of initial performance report. Release requests are submitted by your finance contact and processed within 15 business days. There is an operational setup fee; I can send the standard escrow addendum.

Next steps / asks: 
- Samantha: please confirm whether Acme wants supplier VAT invoices for EU subsidiaries or prefers reverse-charge. If supplier invoices, please send VAT numbers for each bill-to entity.
- Acme finance: confirm PO timing (you mentioned early Sept).
- We (Redwood): will produce a single CSV drawdown tracker and a short owner matrix (who owns VAT evidence, who owns GL mapping).

Attaching: draft-billing-calendar.xlsx (attachment stub).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
